variants.headline: Party leader faces a challenge
variants.body: A party's leader is being challenged in {colony}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Leadership becomes a contested question
variants.body: A challenge to a party leader has opened in the colony. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A challenge inside the party
variants.body: The leadership of a political party is under challenge. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
